NotationDefinition
NThe number of WDs
TThe length of a time slot
TtThe t-th time slot
Ai(t)The arrival computation task data of i-th WD at Tt
λiThe expected value of Ai(t)
Di(t)The executed computation task data of i-th WD at Tt
Ei(t)The energy consumption of i-th WD at Tt
hi(t)The wireless channel gain between the i-th WD and the BS at Tt
gi(t)The wireless channel gain between the i-th WD and the ES at Tt
ξiThe energy harvesting efficiency of i-th WD
PHThe WPT power of the ES
a(t)The proportion of WPT duration to time slot duration at Tt
Ei,H(t)The harvested energy of i-th WD at Tt
EP(t)The energy consumption of the ES at Tt
Di,L(t)The executed computation task data of i-th WD on local computing mode at Tt
Ei,L(t)The energy consumption of i-th WD on local computing mode at Tt
fi(t)The local CPU frequency of i-th WD at Tt
ciThe number of CPU cycles required to process one-bit computation task data by the CPU of i-th WD
κThe energy consumption coefficient
Di,O(t)The executed computation task data of i-th WD on edge computing mode at Tt
ei(t)The energy consumption of i-th WD on edge computing mode at Tt
τi(t)The fraction of time allocated to i-th WD for task offloading at Tt
WThe bandwidth of MEC network
n0The power spectral density of the ECS's receiver noise
Ei,E(t)The energy consumption of ECS to execute the offloaded computation task data from i-th WD at Tt
η0The reciprocal of the energy efficiency of the ECS
xi(t)An offloading indicator for i-th WD at Tt
Qi(t)The data queue of i-th WD at Tt
Bi(t)The battery energy of i-th WD at Tt
Wi(t)The virtual energy queue of i-th WD at Tt
η(k)The reciprocal of the long-term system energy efficiency at k-th time slot
Etot(t)The total energy consumption of the MEC network at Tt
Dtot(t)The total executed computation task data of the MEC network at Tt
EtotThe time-averaged expectation of Etot(t)
DtotThe time-averaged expectation of Dtot(t)
L(t)The Lyapunov function at Tt
ΔL(t)The conditional Lyapunov drift at Tt
Λ(t)The Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty function
VA non-negative parameter to scale the penalty

arrivals \(\mathbf{A}(t)\) for every time slot \(t\) output: The joint action \((\mathbf{x}_t^*,a^* (t),\mathbf{f}_t^*,\mathbf{e}_t^*,\boldsymbol {\tau}_t^*)\) for every   
time slot \(t\) .   
1 Initialize parameters at the first time slot: \(V = 80\)   
\(\delta = 10\) \(\delta_T = 10\) \(M_1 = 2N\) \(\mathbf{Q}(1) = 0\) \(\mathbf{W}(1) = \mathbf{B}^{\mathrm{max}}\) and \(\eta (1) = 0\) .   
for \(t = 1,2,\ldots ,K\) do

4 Generate \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_t = \pi_{\theta_t}(\mathbf{S}_t)\) by the CNN network;   
5 Generate candidate binary offloading decisions \(\{\mathbf{x}_t^m\}_{M_t}\) from \(\hat{\mathbf{x}}_t\) using the NOP method;   
6 Solve the LSEM-E-Sub problem for each \(\mathbf{x}_t^m\) to derive \(R(\mathbf{x}_t^m)\) .   
7 Choose the optimal joint action from (44);   
8 Add \((\mathbf{S}_t,\mathbf{x}_t^*)\) to the replay memory;   
9 if mod \((t,\delta_T) = 0\) then   
10 Uniformly sample a batch of data \(\left\{\left(\mathbf{S}_{\vartheta},\boldsymbol {x}_{\vartheta}\right)\mid \vartheta \in \mathcal{I}\right\}\) from the memory Train the CNN and update \(\theta_t\) .
